{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace('[^0-9.]+', '', regex=True).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
loyal_completed = sales_df[(sales_df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales_df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check if the 999,999.99 value is the only extreme outlier
outlier_threshold = 10000  # Define a threshold for what constitutes an outlier
outliers = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] > outlier_threshold]

print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders with revenue > $10,000: {len(outliers)}")
print("Outlier values:")
print(outliers[['order_id', 'revenue']])"}
